bounds.why: melting point 252 °C: A semicrystalline bar cannot hold its shape above its melting point.

45 °C floor: Heat deflection is measured by heating a loaded bar from room temperature (ISO 75, ASTM D648). A bar soft enough to deflect near room temperature has no meaningful HDT, and no filament in the snapshot measures below 48 °C even at 1.8 MPa. A soft floor, so a PE or BVOH estimate cannot reach below freezing.

polymer.basis: Handbook values; prints amorphous: PET-GF15 81.6 °C as printed and 133.7 °C annealed (DECISIONS D56). Mitsubishi Chemical Advanced Materials' sheet for Ertalyte PET-P (R-MCAM-ERTALYTE-PET-P-DS), an unreinforced, semi-crystalline PET, prints a density of 1.39 g/cm³ (ISO 1183-1) and a specific gravity of 1.41 (ASTM D792), inside the density range, and a melting temperature of 245 °C (ISO 11357-1/-3) beside the row's 252, p. 1. Its water absorption in water at 23 °C is 0.07 % after 24 h (ISO 62 and ASTM D570) and, at saturation, 0.50 % to ISO 62 and 0.9 % to ASTM D570. The Cambridge Materials Data Book (R-CUED-MATERIALS-DATA-BOOK-2003, SHA-256 2bcf739fd66f...) gives PET 1.29-1.4 Mg/m³.

polymerEnvironment.finding: All thermoplastic polyester resins will hydrolyze in hot water. The hydrolysis results in polymer degradation and a decrease in the physical properties of the resin. The rate of hydrolysis depends on exposure conditions; primarily time, temperature and the composition of the specific polyester resin. We recommend that parts made from Rynite should not be used in an environment where there is continuous exposure to water at temperatures above 50 °C.

polymerEnvironment.agent: Outdoor weathering (carbon arc X-W Weather-Ometer, Florida and Arizona exposure)
polymerEnvironment.finding: Thermoplastic polyester resins rank high, among engineering polymers, for resistance to outdoor weathering... in general, Rynite exhibits good property retention. Overall performance is improved, especially impact strength, by the addition of carbon black (> 0,3 % by weight) to the resin. After 10 000 hours in the X-W Weather-Ometer Rynite 530 NC010 and Rynite 545 NC010 retain over 70 % of their initial tensile strength and 55 % of their original elongation properties.
